comment: feat(react-charts): add scope-aware focus preservation after data updates, with explicit reset/disable policies for line, vertical bar, gauge, and declarative consumers. Preserve focus across native removal-induced blur and line-path/marker representation changes. Keep line targets in source coordinates through legend filtering and refresh selected data without remounting open custom callouts. Refresh bar and gauge callouts when their focused elements remain mounted. Remove duplicate story focus restorers and redundant position resets on blur. Equivalent data and callback-only updates do not restore focus. Restoration skips unavailable targets and respects simultaneous controlled legend updates.
